description: ANSWERS: "can I screen a group of lenders", "what ready-made lender groups can I run", "show me an example screen". Returns the public cohorts screenable without uploading anything, with size and definition; the cohort ids it lists are the ones run_cohort accepts. Historical observation computed from the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2). Not a prediction about any individual application. Attribution: FinanceRateCalc, CC BY 4.0.
